recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant FHIR-5695 prose or loosen medication cardinality; any future changes should be handled through the later no-known-medications issue family, especially unresolved FHIR-54566.
issue_request: FHIR-5695 was a Published Pharmacy change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked that MedicationStatement.medication be changed from optional to required, and the final resolution broadened that to making medication 1..1 in all four medication resources.
initial_application: No explicit source commit tagged FHIR-5695 was found. Historical spreadsheet source already showed MedicationStatement.medication[x] as 1..1 before the current StructureDefinition conversion, and the current lineage preserves min/max 1..1 on MedicationStatement and the parallel active medication resources.
additional_context: The current active resources corresponding to the historical four-resource set are MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement; historical MedicationOrder has been replaced by MedicationRequest. Later FHIR-53425 clarified no-known-medications representation by allowing a situation code in the required MedicationStatement.medication element, while unresolved FHIR-54566 only asks for further guidance about interactions with other elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because MedicationStatement.medication and the parallel active medication resource elements are already min=1 and max=1 in authoritative source.

related_jiras.note: Applied follow-up that clarified MedicationStatement.medication can carry a no-known-medications code while remaining required.
